intro.line: Kamigawa, three centuries on: neon, mechs, and spirits that have not gone anywhere.
To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.
A ninja named Kaito has come to Towashi for a chip, and the Imperial guard is looking for him.

finale.line: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.
Jin-Gitaxias is stopped, for now. On New Capenna, the crime families are still sorting out who owns the city.
Recorded: Kamigawa and Capenna each have their endings. The Phyrexians know a lot more than they did.

villainFinale.line: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.
In this version, the praetor gets what he came for, and the city belongs to the machines.

battles.title: The Chip
battles.blurb: Kaito is in Towashi after a chip that could end the Phyrexians. The Imperial guard wants him in a cell.

scene.line: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.
So swift and sharp was his blade that the ogre never even felt the cut.
Ninjutsu: return an unblocked attacker to your hand to put a ninja onto the battlefield, attacking. Hit them where they are not looking.

villainScene.line: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.

hero.half: Attack unblocked, then swap in the ninja.

battles.title: The Moon-Kami
battles.blurb: Armoured kami and mech stand against Jin-Gitaxias's hackers on the Towashi roofs.

scene.line: If your mech is factory standard, you might as well be walking.
Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings. Rise and become the western wind.
Reconfigure: pay the cost and a creature attaches to another as equipment. Pay it again and it unattaches and fights again.

villainScene.line: Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption.
Let's just turn that off, shall we?

hero.half: Attach when you need defense, detach to attack.

battles.title: Families at the Table
battles.blurb: New Capenna: the Maestros and the Brokers meet over dinner. Everyone brought a knife.

scene.line: How far are you willing to go for your family, cleanblade?
Where did I find my horned friend? Now there's a story worth telling. . . .
Shield counters: a creature with one is protected once. If it would be damaged or destroyed, remove the counter instead.

villainScene.line: Regarding the relative might of pen and sword, the official position of the Brokers is "Why choose?"
Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by.

hero.half: Break the shield counter before the real attack.

battles.title: The Demon Who Owns the City
battles.blurb: Elspeth is looking for the Halo. Ob Nixilis already owns half the city.

scene.line: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.
Angels are living proof that power does not always lead to corruption.
Planeswalkers: keep Elspeth alive and she wins the long game. Attack his walker the turn it appears.

villainScene.line: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.
Kill count? I lost track years ago.

battles.title: Connive
battles.blurb: The Riveteers hit the Obscura where it hurts: a vault full of secrets.

scene.line: We are this city, down to its bones.
I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?
Connive: draw a card, then discard a card. If it was a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on the creature.

villainScene.line: Obscura initiates are required to bring a gift of information. They are judged on both how useful it is and how hard it was to obtain.

hero.half: Connive a nonland card to grow the creature.

battles.title: Esper Raffine
battles.blurb: Spring 2022: a three-colour Obscura midrange deck against mono-white weenies.

scene.line: In volatile times, a sense of certainty is in high demand.
This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention.
Trade your removal for their best creature and win with card quality.

villainScene.line: Together we can build a safer, brighter New Capenna!
In the assassination trade, no one lives to make more than one mistake.

hero.half: Do not take too much damage early.

battles.title: Azorius Skies
battles.blurb: Spring 2022: fliers and mech against Naya Runes.

deck.name: The Jukai Order
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Naya Runes is red, green and white; the white is dropped for our land pool.

scene.line: Research is hardly the dry, serious pastime outsiders make it out to be.
Once they swam alone among the clouds, but now the people of Kamigawa have built high enough to reach them.
Get ahead in the air and race. Their big creatures cannot block fliers.

villainScene.line: The kami grant you this boon, not I.
I fear I have run out of worthy opponents.

battles.title: Jin-Gitaxias, Progress Tyrant
battles.blurb: The Praetor wants everything on Kamigawa, and Kaito and Tamiyo are the last ones in his way.

scene.line: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.
For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.
He copies everything he sees. Pressure him early and counter his big plays.

villainScene.line: The Imperials can't arrest you for illegal tech if you never even existed.
Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption.

hero.half: Pressure him and counter the big plays.

half.line: The moon does not obey a machine.

battles.title: Esper Raffine at Full Power
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a three-colour deck that is never out of answers.

archive.what: A three-colour deck built around Raffine, Scheming Seer, cheap interactive creatures, and clean removal.
archive.why: It had the best mana in the format, with cards that were good at every stage of the game.
archive.beat: Kill Raffine early, and keep a Murder for their Ledger Shredder.
archive.after: Dominaria United arrived in autumn 2022 and the format changed again.

deck.name: Esper Midrange
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.
Go under them. They have the better late game.

villainScene.line: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.

after.line: Recorded: Dominaria United arrived in autumn 2022 and the format changed again.
